description: Use this when the user asks about one clinical trial by its registry number (NCT, ISRCTN, ChiCTR, CTRI, CTIS and the rest): its design, outcomes and dates, what changed and when, and which papers cite it. Returns the registry's summary, outcomes and dates, every change recorded and the papers that cite it. A record from the WHO ICTRP carries its attribution and the day WHO processed it, to show with it.

nct_id.description: The trial's registry number, e.g. NCT04488601 or ISRCTN12345678.

name: get_trial
